name: EFN Logo box + ticker
description: The programme's red logo box and, beside it, the beige ticker plate with market values from the EFN ticker feed, 4 per page, turning every few seconds. The ticker starts where the logo box ends. Replaces the Flowics overlays LOGOBOX-* and TICKER-LINE-* PRE / OPEN.

logo.title: Logo box
logo.label: Logo box
logo.description: Programme logo box. BÖRSFRUKOST, MARKNAD and UPDATE show the plate only until their wordmarks are supplied.

group.title: Ticker values
group.label: Ticker values
group.description: Which list of the ticker feed to show.

interval.title: Time per page
interval.label: Time per page
interval.description: How long each page of 4 values stays before the next one, in milliseconds (Flowics default 6 s).

feed.title: Ticker feed URL
feed.label: Ticker feed URL
feed.description: URL of a Flowics JSON datasource with the lists `open` and `pre` (pages of 4 rows). Empty: the EFN ticker feed.

pages.title: Pages
pages.label: Pages (instead of the feed)
pages.description: Ticker pages to show instead of the feed: a list of pages, each a list of up to 4 rows as the feed delivers them. Empty: use the feed.

v_efn.feed: Polled every 5 s in real-time rendering, fetched once in load() in non-real-time rendering. The feed host must allow cross-origin requests (the Flowics datasource sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).
v_efn.canvas: Designed on a 1920x1080 canvas; scales to any 16:9 output. Render UHD for the sharpest rims.
